title: Lion Marked Egg
description: Gives the egg the British Lion mark
body:
Picture this; on day, you're walking along the overworld when a chicken lays an egg right in front of you! You must be thinking _"Oh sweet! great for some egg and breakfast!"_ **Get Real!** You can't eat that! There's no way to tell if its safe!

This resource pack fixes that issue by giving the egg a British Lion Mark, which is a small red printing on eggs that have been produced to the highest food saftey standards, so you don't need to worry about the dangers of eating eggs you quite literally found on the street!

![Egg in an item frame](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3246ffe42fedff7a55eea0e92fa6584965ecd3c5.png)
